usageNotes: Use this to retrieve the member list and optional comment for a specific Proxmox access group. The caller must hold either Sys.Audit or Group.Allocate on /access/groups. The group must already exist; a non-existent groupid returns an error, not an empty result.
tips: The members array contains full user IDs in name@realm format (e.g. jdoe@pve); iterate it to build audit reports or compare expected vs. actual group membership.
API tokens are allowed (allowtoken: true), so automation scripts can read group data without interactive credentials.
Group IDs are case-sensitive and follow the pve-groupid format; use list_access_groups first if unsure of exact casing.
